Design principles

  • • Compact enough for avatar, favicon and watermark
  • • Wordmark spelling LLAMAAAJ stays exact

Creative thinking with a clear structure.
The symbol is built to work alone (avatar / icon / stamp); the wordmark must work alone on signage and documents.

Selected Concept

Selected: A — Interlocking LL

Chosen for the most ownable silhouette: two L forms share one structure, and the overlap becomes a knocked-out square — structure (the grid) plus creativity (the cut). It holds at avatar scale and in one colour. B stays on file for the workspace idea but its corner gaps thin at 16 px; C reads as a bar chart.

Next: build on a modular grid, correct optically, test small sizes, then apply colour only after the monochrome version is approved.
